pr_title: statistics: update some vars for internal sessions correctly
pr_body:

### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

There MUST be one line starting with "Issue Number:  " and

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

Issue Number: close https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/53972

Problem Summary:

### What changed and how does it work?

We need to always update these vars for internal sessions. Otherwise, it won't work. And we will use the wrong default value.

See more at the issue.
